opportunities.name: Movie night email from IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes
opportunities.description: For a movie, look up its IMDb rating and Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer, then draft a 'Movie night' email to a friend with the ratings and discard the draft.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Note director, runtime and IMDb rating
Search the title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Movie night <day>: <title>' and a body with director, runtime, IMDb and Tomatometer

instances.values: The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday

opportunities.name: npm package stats note via GitHub
opportunities.description: For an npm package, search npmjs, open the package and its GitHub repo releases, then save a note with version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: Search the package name on npmjs
Open the package page and read version, weekly downloads, license
Open Releases and read stars, issues and last release date
Add a note in the notes app summarizing the stats

opportunities.name: Recipe summary note from Allrecipes and Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a dish, find the recipe on Allrecipes, look up its origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings, rating, time, key ingredients and origin.
steps: Open the top recipe and read rating, time and ingredients
Search the dish on Wikipedia and read the origin
Add a note in the notes app with servings, recipe details, ingredients and origin
